idea-plugin.name: AEP-X Agentic IDE
idea-plugin.description:
Opens the AEP-X Agentic IDE: a universal, governed workspace where an AI agent crew plans and produces your work, you approve each step, and every decision is audited. Nine IDEs share one platform: Software, Sound, Music, Movie & Film, Animation, SDK, Social Media, Multimedia and Media.
  • Tools | AEP-X | Open Agentic IDE
  • Tools | AEP-X | New Project: start a project in any of the nine IDEs
  • Tools | AEP-X | Plans and Pricing: 30-day free trial with ads, then £4.99/month for 95% fewer ads, or the free ad-supported plan.
The plugin reads no project files, stores no credentials and makes no network requests itself.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.3.0: nine IDE modules (software, sound, music, film, animation, SDK, social, multimedia, media), real AI agents with human approval, roles and a tamper-evident audit trail.
